summary: Backend + frontend verification of Brightluxx image/redirect/cache fixes. All 13 pytest cases pass (products limit + full catalog + category filter; projects 8-count + external WebP URLs reachable HTTP 200 + limit; /api/cdn/* 301 redirect with flattened path; /api/products/hjdba 404 tombstone; Cache-Control public,max-age=300 on /api/homepage-content, /api/site-settings, /api/seo/page-meta, /api/products via localhost:8001). Build artifacts verified: our-works/, about-us/, products/hjdba/ each contain meta refresh + canonical + robots noindex; zero build HTML references /downloaded-images/ or /generated-images/. Frontend regression on preview URL: homepage PRODUCT FAMILIES section shows 5 cards all with opt_fam_*.webp and naturalWidth>0; /projects lists 8 cards with 11/11 images loaded (0 broken); /products lists 94 product links with 52/52 images loaded; product detail (gamewall-sim-180) shows specs and 9/9 images loaded. No broken image icons observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate /api/cdn/{path} route: defined in both backend/routes/public.py (legacy_cdn_redirect) and backend/routes/redirects.py. Only one wins at registration time. Consider removing the copy from public.py to keep a single source of truth (redirects.py).

get_projects uses cursor.to_list(length=min(limit,100)) — if a caller filters by featured with limit=3 the DB returns only 3 docs, which happens to align with the requirement. That behaviour is fine, just note that sort() is applied inside Mongo pipeline before length truncation so ordering is correct. No action needed.

get_products applies `limit` in Python (products[:limit]) after fetching up to 200 docs — acceptable for catalog size ~94 but consider pushing limit into MongoDB `to_list(length=limit)` if catalog grows past a few hundred to avoid unnecessary serialization.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_brightluxx_fixes.py is the reusable regression suite for image URL, CDN redirect, cache header, tombstone, and product/project limit fixes. It auto-loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env, and TestCacheHeaders hits localhost:8001 directly (preview ingress overrides Cache-Control to no-store — that is by design). Frontend was validated on the preview URL using data-testid-free heuristics; PRODUCT FAMILIES / PROJECTS section walker returns whatever section contains at least 3 images.
